svg.text: Door lintels: two pieces 1,140 mm long, one over each leaf.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Pad lintels: two pieces 940 mm long, one over each leaf.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Section 115 wide (the leaf width) by 100 mm deep. Saw square,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Each lintel bears 150 mm on the brick at both ends of the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: opening, bedded in mortar, level, flush with both leaf faces.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Door lintels: underside 1,920 mm above ground. Pad lintels:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Leave the cavity open between the two lintels of a pair; the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: fill above runs down between them onto the lining head.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: level, 150 mm bearing both ends, no rot or splits.
